fields.name: timer1_load_count_register
fields.desc: Value to be loaded into Timer1. This is the value from which counting commences. Any value written to this register is loaded into the associated timer. Reset Value: `32'b0`

fields.name: timer1_current_value_register
fields.desc: Current Value of Timer1. Reset Value: `32'b0`
Reserved, read as zero

fields.name: timer_hardware_trigger_enable
fields.desc: `0` = timer hardware trigger disable; `1` = timer hardware trigger enable
Reserved, read as zero

fields.name: timer_interrupt_mask
fields.desc: `0` = timer interrupt not masked; `1` = timer interrupt masked. Reset Value: `1'b0`

fields.name: timer_mode_select
fields.desc: `0` = free-running; `1` = user-defined running. Reset Value: `1'b0`

fields.name: timer_enable_select
fields.desc: `0` = disabled; `1` = enabled. Reset Value: `1'b0`
Reserved, read as zero

fields.name: timer1_int_clr_register
fields.desc: Reading from this register returns all zeros (`0`) and clears the interrupt from Timer1
Reserved, read as zero

fields.name: timer1int_status_register
fields.desc: Contains the interrupt status for Timer1
